about_the_game:
A Pinball/Pachinko/Bubble Shooter mashup where you play as "Arf", a so-called pirate dwarf who must adventure alone into the depths of the mines to slay the evil that lurks below. Unlike the other dwarves, he prefers to battle with an array of unique balls he blasts out of his cannon - from a safe distance within his "pirate ship".

Firstly, you must launch your ball into the mine-shaft, hitting pegs and bumpers alike to power up your ball. Striking at ores will generate 'frenzy', further increasing your potential damage. Use you flippers to keep the ball in play and look out for unique objects on the board, such as extra cannons or even a wyvern head?

Once you've powered up your ball, unleash it onto the battlefield and wreak havoc. Balls have unique traits that can help in a fight - such as exploding, electrification in an area, and can even summon a trusty dwarf to fight by your side!

Fight your way through 3 levels and craft your perfect loudout. Explore the combinations of relics, balls, and runes and take advantage of synergies to dominate your foes.

Feature List:

  • Ball board effects: These can effect the gameplay in the mining phase. Such as multiball, scattershot, and feather.

  • Ball battle effects: These can effect the gameplay in the battle phase. Such as totems, shields, and area damagers.

  • Relics: These can effect gameplay at any time. Such as granting buffs to balls, protecting you from harm, or even spawning a parrot?

  • Explore the map in 3D: All traversal takes place in a realised world, meet fellow dwarves during random events and maybe even befriend an elf! (If you really want to...)

  • Built to be emergent: All aspects of the game interacts with each other meaning that anything can happen with the correct combination of balls/relics/events/enemies/etc...

short_description: Play as a Dwarven 'Pirate' and set sail on your modified minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball, Pachinko, and Bubble Shooter whilst collecting game altering balls & relics that ensure no two runs are alike.
supported_languages: English, French, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Thai
